name: Major Mattingly
summary: At Stormwind’s main gates, Major Mattingly helps guard the capital and advises crafters on protection from dragons.

sections.title: Sentinel of the Capital Gates
sections.body: Major Mattingly is a high-ranking officer responsible for Stormwind City's landward defense. He stands watch in the Valley of Heroes under General Marcus Jonathan, alongside the city's garrison. His duties include overseeing gate patrols and travelers entering the city. Mattingly also knows the lethal nature of dragons and guides skilled crafters who seek to make protective dragonscale gear for facing dangerous lairs.

faq.q: Where can Major Mattingly be found?
faq.answer: Major Mattingly keeps watch just inside Stormwind City's main gates, in the Valley of Heroes, alongside the garrison.

faq.q: What is Major Mattingly's rank and role in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Major Mattingly is a Stormwind Army officer under General Marcus Jonathan. He helps oversee the city's gate defenses and gives military guidance to adventurers.

faq.q: Why do leatherworkers seek out Major Mattingly?
aliases: the journey has just begun mattingly
faq.answer: Leatherworkers seek Major Mattingly for instructions on treating black dragonhide and crafting scale cloaks that protect allies from dragonfire.

faq.q: Is Major Mattingly involved in any broader conflicts?
faq.answer: Major Mattingly is a battle-hardened veteran of the Kingdom of Stormwind. He devotes himself to defending the realm while King Varian Wrynn is missing and the kingdom faces lingering threats.

angles.text: For Alliance champions challenging great dragons like Onyxia, Major Mattingly offers guidance on crafting protective cloaks from dragon scales.
As a disciplined veteran with a longsword at Stormwind's gates, Major Mattingly reflects the steadfast resolve of the Stormwind Army's infantry officers.
